doc.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001

title: Rich's temper and personality
summary: Kay refuses to write a book; mentions Rich's honorary black belt and board breaking.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players

blocks.x: He seemed to have a — on one hand be really filled with fun and everything, and he had a temper too, is that right?

Oh yeah. Well I always say, people want me to write a book about it but I believe here the man’s gone, he can’t defend himself or whatever is what I would say. But see he did that black belt stuff. He wasn’t a black belt, he was an honorary black belt. He could break the boards and everybody got afraid. He’d go HUH and the boards broke, and they’d go, “don’t play around with him,” you know? So that was the part of his make-up.
